input.brief: Invite Maya to the birthday party on Saturday 21 November at 19h at home. Language: English (requested). Tone: friend.

draft.subject: Birthday party on Saturday!
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

I'm having a birthday party at my place on Saturday 21 November at 7 pm and I'd love you to come! Let me know if you can make it.

See you soon,
Léa
